title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: In parallelogram \(ABCD\) shown, what is the area of the shaded region \(BEDC?\)

solutions.text:
The parallelogram has base \(10\) and height \(8,\) so its area is \(10 \times 8 = 80.\)

The unshaded triangle \(ABE\) has base \(AE = AD - ED = 10 - 6 = 4\) and height \(8,\) so its area is \(\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 8 = 16.\) The shaded area is \(80 - 16 = 64.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The shaded region is the whole parallelogram with the triangle \(ABE\) removed
The parallelogram area is \(10 \times 8;\) triangle \(ABE\) has base \(AE = 10 - 6\) and height \(8\)
